item.title: Nutch will migrate to Java 17
item.description: Nutch v1.22 will be the last version to run on Java 11. Starting with the development of version 1.23 we will migrate to Java 17. To run or compile Nutch, a Java 17 runtime (JRE) and JDK will then be required. See also the discussion on the Nutch development mailing list.
